title: Familiar
subtitle: Specification & screen walkthrough
label: LOCAL PROTOTYPE · NOVEMBER 2026
narration: Familiar aims to personalize educational videos with a registered, consenting parent’s face and voice. This walkthrough separates the current local prototype from planned features. All examples are synthetic. The narrator is a stock computer voice, not a parent or child.

title: What the product must do
subtitle: One family. Explicit consent. Guardian review.
label: PRODUCT SPECIFICATION
narration: The specification calls for web, iOS, and Android clients sharing a family-scoped API. A parent must consent before enrollment and conversion. Revocation must stop downstream use. A guardian must review output before a child can see it. Real authentication and conversion are not implemented.

title: 01 / Home
subtitle: Current web screen
label: ACTUAL LOCAL WEB CAPTURE
narration: This is the actual web Home screen. The permanent banner explains that identity is only a development header claim, not a secure login. The navigation contains Home, Review, and Dev settings. English and Japanese are available. There is no capture or media playback.

title: 02 / Dev settings
subtitle: Configure the synthetic demo
label: ACTUAL LOCAL WEB CAPTURE
narration: Dev settings accepts the API base URL, family ID, and guardian ID. These example values are synthetic, not credentials. Save stores the development settings locally, and Check API health checks connectivity. The local walkthrough server is read only and refuses all write requests.

title: 03 / Review list
subtitle: Open a family job
label: ACTUAL LOCAL WEB CAPTURE
narration: Review loads the synthetic family job list from the local API. Each row shows a job identifier and status. Select a row to fetch its details, or use Refresh to reload. Empty and error states are implemented. Foreign-family or malformed data is refused.

title: 04 / Job details
subtitle: Status is not permission to release
label: ACTUAL LOCAL WEB CAPTURE
narration: The detail screen shows the selected job, its status, target enrollment, and update time. Back to jobs returns to the list. Preview is explicitly unavailable. There is no approve or release button. A needs-review status does not mean any playable or converted video exists.

title: 05 / Native entry
subtitle: iOS & Android: fixture mode first
label: ILLUSTRATION · NOT A DEVICE CAPTURE
narration: These are illustrations based on the current SwiftUI and Compose source, not verified device captures. Both clients start with synthetic fixture data. They show a guardian job list, details, and an unavailable-preview message. iOS is still a reusable package without a complete app host.

title: 06 / Native connection
subtitle: An explicit development option
label: ILLUSTRATION · UNVERIFIED NETWORK FLOW
narration: The native development forms request an HTTPS endpoint and synthetic family and guardian IDs. Cancel returns to fixture mode. Connect is intended to load read-only metadata. Settings stay in memory. A trusted HTTPS endpoint and device testing are still needed; this flow is not verified end to end.

title: 07 / Native review
subtitle: Fresh details, refresh and back
label: ILLUSTRATION · UNVERIFIED DEVICE FLOW
narration: Connected native views are designed to fetch the list and fresh details, show loading and errors, and discard late results after leaving a screen. Disconnect returns to fixtures. Neither adapter exposes approval, release, or media playback. Android builds and native navigation tests remain unverified.

title: Planned / consent & enrollment
subtitle: Design intent, not implemented screens
label: PLANNED · ILLUSTRATIVE WIREFRAMES
narration: The planned flow begins with secure guardian sign-in, explicit consent, and parent enrollment. Consent choices must start unchecked. Voice and face capture must wait for valid consent and the required privacy review. The boxes here are illustrative wireframes. These screens and capture capabilities are not implemented.

title: Planned / conversion to playback
subtitle: Every release stays behind guardian review
label: PLANNED · ILLUSTRATIVE WIREFRAMES
narration: Next, a guardian would provide a source, choose a registered in-family parent, and request conversion. The backend would recheck consent, then create a preview for guardian approval or rejection. Only approved output could reach a child. Real conversion, preview, approval delivery, and child playback remain unfinished.

title: What works / what comes next
subtitle: A review prototype, not a finished family app
label: STATUS & VALIDATION LIMITS
narration: Today, the local web review demo works with synthetic metadata. Two hundred and five JavaScript and TypeScript tests pass. Swift API smoke checks pass, but SwiftUI tooling blocks a full build. Android tooling is absent. No native end-to-end verification, production login, real enrollment, conversion, or media release is claimed.
